summary: Current main signal emitter has two material data-quality problems: malformed model JSON becomes fabricated neutral score/confidence 50/0.5, and malformed or timezone-naive news timestamps are admitted because parse failures are ignored; non-finite relevance weights are not rejected. Draft PR #1324 proposes strict classifier schema validation, finite/timestamp checks, explicit descriptive-score semantics and forecast_status=NOT_ISSUED with a structured no-forecast record. Four regression tests were added to the already CI-listed tests/test_v3_scripts.py. PR #1324 is based on current main 750ccb and has 3 commits ahead/0 behind; no CI/gate run was visible at capture. PR #1323's read-only merge queue has passing CI and gate but is now one commit behind main due to a paper-trading log-only commit. Main's paper trader remains scheduled and has a nonzero simulated position with product identity null. The public XRP signal remains score 44/confidence 0.0 with provider failures. No market features admitted; no forecast issued.

findings.claim: Current main scripts/emit_signal.py returns score 50/confidence 0.5/neutral when model response parsing fails. If both providers fail, it returns score 0/confidence 0.0, then blends score with the news score when news exists. The emitted artifact does not explicitly mark forecast status or distinguish descriptive sentiment from return prediction.
findings.limitation: The current artifact is a sentiment/news summary, not a calibrated price forecast. No forecast issued.

findings.claim: Current _news_score ignores timestamp parse failures and does not reject non-finite relevance weights or unknown sentiment labels. Such rows can distort a rolling-window feature. PR #1324 adds strict exclusion and regression tests.
findings.limitation: The number of affected historical rows has not been measured; no retrospective feature or score rewrite was performed.

findings.claim: PR #1324 changes only scripts/emit_signal.py and tests/test_v3_scripts.py, adds four deterministic tests, and was created from main 750ccbaf. Remote compare reports 3 commits ahead, 0 behind. Files were read back; CI/gate not visible at capture.
findings.limitation: Draft and unmerged; do not claim tests pass until exact-head CI and gate are observed.

findings.claim: PR #1323's read-only merge-queue workflow passed 187 tests plus 4 subtests in 6.65 seconds, including both new regression tests, and the fail-closed gate passed.
findings.limitation: Draft and unmerged. Main advanced one log-only commit after the PR base; current mergeability must be rechecked before approval.

findings.claim: Main still runs the paper trader every 30 minutes and commits/pushes its state/log. State remains position_size 0.012445158497236623, position_product null, average entry 80436.84, cash about 9009.94, trade_count 126.
findings.limitation: PR #1320 remains draft/unmerged. Full historical log replay remains blocked; state was not mutated.

findings.claim: The prior unintended data-only relationship graph file remains on main. PR #1308 remains open, draft and unmerged.
findings.limitation: Main has not been restored to its prior tree; no merge or deletion was performed.
